why_ai: Readers subscribe to a trusted voice, but AI summaries compete directly with curation newsletters.
why_clarity: Daily issues recur and clicks arrive fast, but quality is editorial taste and opens are broken.
why_digital: Sources, writing, delivery and ad sales all happen online.

why_ai: Inventory, insertion and reporting are mechanical work ad-ops software absorbs.
why_clarity: Every send repeats insertion and reporting, but neither side trusts the measured numbers.
why_digital: Rate cards, insertions and reports handled in spreadsheets and email platforms.

why_ai: Inferring placement from opaque mailbox providers is hard, but it is inference and operations software.
why_clarity: Inbox placement is the clear goal, but providers report almost nothing to confirm it.
why_digital: Email sends, authentication and engagement data, all digital.

why_ai: Filtering a stable source set for audience relevance is ranking learned from the archive.
why_clarity: The same question every morning with engagement as signal, though relevance involves editorial judgment.
why_digital: Feeds and archives in, ranked story candidates out.

why_ai: Attributing source quality to downstream engagement is analytics over the publisher's own records.
why_clarity: Engagement by acquisition source is measurable, though it accrues over weeks.
why_digital: Signup sources and engagement records, purchased and analyzed online.

why_ai: Propensity, timing and churn prediction are standard models over reader behaviour.
why_clarity: Conversion and renewal are binary outcomes, observed at billing cycles.
why_digital: Reader engagement and billing data in, targeted offers out.

why_ai: Estimating landing placement from behavioural records is a statistical model.
why_clarity: Every send repeats the estimate, but providers never confirm where mail actually landed.
why_digital: Send and engagement logs by provider in, placement estimates out.

why_ai: Per-subscriber timing and content selection is a well-posed personalisation model.
why_clarity: Engagement lift from timing and segment choices is measured on every send.
why_digital: Engagement history in, personalised send schedules out.

why_ai: Suppression and authentication against published provider thresholds is policy automation.
why_clarity: Published complaint thresholds and postmaster data give checkable daily targets.
why_digital: Authentication records, complaint data and list hygiene, all in software.

why_ai: Calendar, insertion, proofing and sponsor reports are almost entirely mechanical.
why_clarity: Each placement and report is a defined, repeated deliverable checked against the sponsor order.
why_digital: Creative, copy, sends and reports handled entirely on screen.

why_ai: The writer's voice is the product readers pay for, though AI compresses the reading beforehand.
why_clarity: The daily deadline repeats, but what matters to readers and good writing are taste.
why_digital: Reading, writing and publishing all happen on screen.
